Discover the perfect outdoor escape at River Hideout Campground, where cozy accommodations meet natural beauty. River Hideout's Pod House represents the pinnacle of modern eco-friendly architecture, offering a luxurious escape into nature. This 2 person compact, innovative structure is designed to provide not only a unique experience but also functionality.  Whether you're seeking a peaceful retreat for a couple or a fun-filled weekend, our POD is designed to provide comfort and making your stay both memorable and affordable. Reserve the POD today and experience the tranquility of the outdoors.

Rental includes bedding and towels
